ov: Small burrowing mammals with velvety fur, tiny eyes and ears, and big, powerful front paws for digging. Gardeners see them as pests, but they aerate the soil and eat slugs and root-eating grubs.
rg: Most of North America, Europe (except Ireland) and Asia.
df: Earthworms and other small soil invertebrates.
fx: African golden moles and Australian marsupial moles live the same way but aren’t related.
notes: Group entry. The existing fact (paralysed live earthworms in a larder) is confirmed: toxic saliva paralyses the worms, and larders with over a thousand have been found.
